definitions.public_sector: All institutional units controlled by government: general government plus public non-financial and financial corporations.
definitions.general_government: ESA 2010 sector S.13: central and local government and social-security funds, including controlled non-market units.
definitions.public_corporations: Government-controlled market producers and public financial corporations, including the central bank.
definitions.fte: Full-time-equivalent jobs. Persons, positions and budgeted posts are retained as different units and never silently converted.
